rainium.add.empty_hint: Drop .obj, .gltf or .glb models (and .png textures), or a folder or .zip of them, into the rainium folder.
rainium.bundle.note.extra_textures: %s uses %s more texture(s) than could be applied.
rainium.bundle.note.no_faces: %s has no faces and was skipped.
rainium.bundle.note.resized: %s was not sized in blocks and was fitted to 2 blocks.
rainium.bundle.note.texture_format: %s is not a texture format the game can read and was skipped.
rainium.msg.bundle_added_missing: Added %s: %s layer(s), %s without a texture (see the log)
rainium.edit.empty_hint: Use + Add layer to start from a preset or your own model.
rainium.import.no_faces: This file has no faces to show.
rainium.import.warn.extra_textures: The model uses %s more texture(s); only the first one is kept.
rainium.import.warn.no_faces: No faces in this file (only f lines can be rendered).
rainium.import.warn.no_uvs: No UVs: textures will show as one colour.
rainium.import.warn.texture_not_png: The model's texture isn't a PNG, so it wasn't kept. Save it as a PNG next to the model to use it.
rainium.import.warn.too_big: %s blocks across: try centimetres or Fit.
rainium.import.warn.too_small: Only %s blocks across: scale it up.
rainium.label.one_layer_per_part_in_a_fo: One layer per part, in a folder
rainium.layers.empty_hint: Add one from the presets or your own models.
rainium.name: Rainium
rainium.preset.halo.description: A floating gold ornament behind the head (example model)
rainium.preset.group.nocturne.descriptio: A moon in a halo, turning in place beside you.
rainium.tip.spin_around: What the layer turns around: itself, one of the body parts, or another layer. Choose another layer to circle it; the layer itself stays put.
rainium.tip.spin: Turns the layer around an upright axis, in degrees per second (negative turns the other way). Set what it turns around under Spin around.
rainium.preset.glow_halo.description: A soft glowing ring over the head with pink sparkles
rainium.preset.wings.needs_mod: The source mod is needed, then disable it.
rainium.msg.opening_mod_page: Opening the mod's page in your browser...
rainium.preset.wings.description: Feathered wings with eyes, glow and an optional aura
rainium.preview.no_world: Join a world to see the preview
rainium.tip.armor_stands: Default for layers that don't choose their own: also show them on armor stands with the name below (give one a name tag). Only you see them.
rainium.tip.attach_to: What the layer follows. Body follows crouching and leaning, Head turns with your head, Body (no lean) stays upright, and arms and legs swing as you walk. Left and right are your own.
rainium.tip.automatic_updates: Once per launch, checks Rainium's GitHub releases for a newer version made for this Minecraft version, downloads it and installs it when you close the game. GitHub can see your IP address when it checks.
rainium.tip.axes: How the model was oriented when exported. Blender's default OBJ export is Y up, facing +Z.
rainium.tip.back: Moves it backwards, in blocks (negative goes forwards). Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.bob_speed: How fast the idle bob repeats.
rainium.tip.capture_menu: Size, frame rate and spin for pictures and recordings.
rainium.tip.capture_fps: Frames per second for recordings. Set the same rate when importing the frames into a video editor.
rainium.tip.capture_size: Resolution of pictures and recordings, compared with the preview on your screen. Bigger takes more disk space and can drop frames while recording.
rainium.tip.capture_spin: Turns the preview while recording: slow is one turn every 12 seconds, fast every 6.
rainium.tip.copy_error: Copies the error text, to paste into a bug report or message.
rainium.tip.copy_style: Remembers this layer's look and placement, to paste onto another layer.
rainium.tip.custom_name: The name shown in folder paths. Click to type, Enter to save.
rainium.tip.damping: How quickly the bounce settles. Lower is wobblier.
rainium.tip.dev_updates: Also installs dev builds: early versions between main releases (like 0.3.1) that may have new features or bugs. Off by default.
rainium.tip.down: Moves it down, in blocks (negative goes up). Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.duplicate: Adds a copy of this layer right below it.
rainium.tip.export_zip: Makes a zip in the exports folder with these parts and their model and texture files. Others can add it from Add > Shared sets.
rainium.tip.fine_tune_motion: Shows every motion setting, for exact control.
rainium.tip.fit_to: Resizes the model so its largest side is this many blocks.
rainium.tip.folder: Which folder this layer belongs to.
rainium.tip.hide_while_gliding: Hides this layer while flying with an elytra.
rainium.tip.hue: Shifts every colour of the texture around the colour wheel. 0° keeps the original colours; ±180° is the opposite colour. Click the strip, scroll, or click the value to type.
rainium.tip.idle_bob: Gentle up-and-down motion while standing still.
rainium.tip.idle_sway: Gentle side-to-side motion while standing still.
rainium.tip.ignore_world_light: Draws at full brightness, even in the dark.
rainium.tip.left: Moves it sideways, in blocks (negative goes right). Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.max_trail: The furthest layers can trail behind, in blocks.
rainium.tip.max_turn: The most layers can lag when turning, in degrees.
rainium.tip.me_uuids: Entity UUIDs that count as you, so they get your "Just me" layers. Use it for yourself in a Flashback replay, where you watch through a camera: paste the entity UUID Flashback shows (Ctrl+V), or click Me next to yourself below. Separate several with commas.
rainium.tip.mirrored_copy: Also draws a left/right mirrored copy, e.g. model one wing, show two. On an arm or leg, the copy goes on the other arm or leg.
rainium.tip.model: The mesh file this layer uses, from the rainium folder.
rainium.tip.model_axes: Pick Blender (Y up) if a model exported from Blender shows up upside-down or backwards.
rainium.tip.motion: How strongly this folder's parts sway with movement. 0% keeps them still, 100% is normal.
rainium.tip.motion_feel: How much your cosmetics move: from completely still to very bouncy. Applies to every layer with "Sway with movement" on.
rainium.tip.name_in_paths: What replaces your computer's account name wherever a folder path is shown, here and in messages: your in-game name, a name you choose, or nothing (~).
rainium.tip.normals: Lighting direction per vertex. From file is usually right; Flat gives a faceted look.
rainium.tip.on_players: Which players this shows on. Default follows the folder, then Settings > Visibility.
rainium.tip.on_stands: Whether this shows on armor stands, and on which names. Default follows the folder, then Settings > Visibility.
rainium.tip.opacity: How see-through the layer is. Affects the See-through and Glow styles. Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.origin_at: Feet if the model was made around a full-size character; Neck if made around a Minecraft player's neck.
rainium.tip.p_angle: Upright: every particle starts the right way up (Spin still turns them). Random: each starts at a random angle.
rainium.tip.p_area: Radius of the ball or ring, or half the width of the box, in blocks.
rainium.tip.p_end_size: How big particles are at the end of their life. 0 shrinks them away.
rainium.tip.p_fade: Particles become see-through as they age.
rainium.tip.p_follow: On: particles move along with you. Off: they stay where they appeared, leaving a trail.
rainium.tip.p_gravity: Pulls particles down as they move. Negative values make them rise.
rainium.tip.p_life: How long each particle lasts, in seconds (each one varies a little).
rainium.tip.p_rate: How many particles appear per second.
rainium.tip.p_shape: Where around the attachment point particles appear: one point, inside a ball, inside a box, or around a flat ring.
rainium.tip.p_size: How big particles are when they appear, in blocks.
rainium.tip.p_speed: How fast particles start moving, in blocks per second.
rainium.tip.p_spin: How fast each particle turns, in degrees per second.
rainium.tip.p_spread: How far each particle may stray from the direction, in degrees. 180 is any direction.
rainium.tip.p_when: When particles appear: all the time, only while moving, only while standing still, or more the faster you move.
rainium.tip.part: Which part of the model this layer draws. Whole model draws every part.
rainium.tip.particle_texture: The picture each particle shows: one of Minecraft's particles, or a PNG you put in the rainium folder.
rainium.tip.paste_style: Applies the copied look and placement to this layer (keeps its model and texture).
rainium.tip.picture: Saves a PNG of the preview with a transparent background, in the captures folder.
rainium.tip.players: Player names, separated by commas. Add your own name to include yourself.
rainium.tip.players_here: Players loaded around you, with the start of each entity UUID. In a replay these are the recorded players: click Me next to yourself.
rainium.tip.record: Records the preview as numbered PNG frames with a transparent background. Video editors import the folder as one clip.
rainium.tip.remove_folder: Deletes these parts from your setup. Their files stay in the rainium folder.
rainium.tip.reset_preset: Puts this layer back the way the preset made it.
rainium.tip.roll: Rotation around the front-to-back axis, in degrees.
rainium.tip.scale: Extra scaling on top of the units. Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.show_on: Default for layers that don't choose their own: whose player shows them (only you, everyone, other players, players you list, or nobody). Only you see the result.
rainium.tip.size: Scale of the model in %. Click the value to type an exact number.
rainium.tip.split_by: How the model's pieces become parts you can style separately.
rainium.tip.springiness: How quickly layers spring back into place. Higher is snappier.
rainium.tip.stand_name: Armor stands with exactly this name tag (not case-sensitive) show your layers.
rainium.tip.stand_names: Name tags of the armor stands this shows on, separated by commas (not case-sensitive).
rainium.tip.starter_aura: A soft glow swirling around you.
rainium.tip.starter_blank: A plain emitter to set up yourself.
rainium.tip.starter_hearts: Hearts floating up while you stand still.
rainium.tip.starter_sparkles: Glitter drifting up around your back.
rainium.tip.starter_trail: Sparks left behind you as you move.
rainium.tip.step_size: How much each − / + click or scroll changes a value.
rainium.tip.style: Solid is opaque. See-through uses the texture's transparency. Glow adds light (black stays invisible); Soft glow is gentler. One-sided hides back faces.
rainium.tip.sway_speed: How fast the idle sway repeats.
rainium.tip.sway_with_movement: Lets the layer trail behind and sway as you move and turn.
rainium.tip.texture: The PNG painted onto the model. None draws it plain white.
rainium.tip.tilt: Rotation around the side-to-side axis, in degrees.
rainium.tip.tint: Colours the whole layer towards a colour: click the strip to pick it, and set how strong. Off keeps the original colours. Hue shifts the texture first, then Tint colours the result.
rainium.tip.trail: How far layers trail behind when you move.
rainium.tip.turn: Rotation around the vertical axis, in degrees.
rainium.tip.turn_lag: How much layers lag behind when you turn.
rainium.tip.ungroup: Keeps the parts as separate layers and removes the folder.
rainium.tip.units: The units the model was made in. Minecraft blocks are 1 metre.
rainium.update.ready: Rainium %s is downloaded and will be installed when you close the game.
rainium.value.anchor.head: Head
rainium.tutorial.invite.title: New to Rainium?
rainium.tutorial.invite.body:
Take a short tour: where to find the editor, how to add a model, and how to place, recolour and show it.
It takes about a minute and you can skip it at any point.
rainium.tutorial.invite.note: You can replay it any time from Settings.
rainium.tutorial.news.title: Rainium %s is here
rainium.tutorial.news.body:
- New **sample models** in Add > Presets: Glow halo, and Nocturne in two forms. Every one has a sharp picture.
- Layers can **spin** around themselves, a body part or another layer.
- Eyed wings is always listed, and lights up once its mod is found.
rainium.tutorial.skip.title: Leave the tour
rainium.tutorial.skip.body: You're on step %s of %s. Nothing you've changed is lost, and the editor stays open.
rainium.tutorial.skip.note: You can replay it any time from **Settings › Tutorial**.
rainium.tutorial.open.title: Find Rainium in Mods
rainium.tutorial.open.body:
Rainium has its own editor. From the title screen or the pause menu:
- Click **Mods**, then pick **Rainium** in the list.
- Press **Configure…** to open the editor.
rainium.tutorial.open.note: In a world you can also press **K** or type **/rainium**.
rainium.tutorial.tour.title: Four areas to know
rainium.tutorial.tour.body:
- **1 Tabs:** Edit, Add and Settings.
- **2 Layers:** everything you've added, in one list.
- **3 Preview:** your player, live.
- **4 Panel:** the settings for what's selected.
rainium.tutorial.own.title: Bring your own model
rainium.tutorial.own.body:
Rainium reads **.obj**, **.gltf** and **.glb** models.
- Press **Open rainium folder** and drop your files in. Put a texture (**.png** or **.jpg**) next to its model.
- A whole **folder** or a **.zip** works too: Rainium finds every model and texture inside and matches each model to its texture for you.
- Whatever it finds shows under **Your models**. One click adds it.
rainium.tutorial.halo.title: Try the Gold halo
rainium.tutorial.halo.body: Press **Add** on the Gold halo. It's a ready-made example, so you can see how everything works.
rainium.tutorial.halo.note: Or press Next and it's set up for you.
rainium.tutorial.shape.title: The halo is on your player
rainium.tutorial.shape.body:
Select a part in the list and the panel shows its settings. Try these:
- **Look:** model, texture, style, hue and opacity.
- **Size** scales it. **Left, Down, Back** slide it; **Tilt, Turn, Roll** rotate it.
- Press − or + to step a value, or click a number to type one.
rainium.tutorial.layers.title: Everything lives in the list
rainium.tutorial.layers.body:
- **1 Circle:** click the circle beside a layer or folder to show or hide it.
- **2 Arrow:** folds a folder open or closed.
- **3 Up / Down:** reorder. **Add layer** adds more.
- **4 Undo and Redo** take back any change.
rainium.tutorial.particles.title: Glowing bits around you
rainium.tutorial.particles.body:
Particles are small effects that drift off your player.
- Press a starter: **Sparkles**, **Embers**, **Hearts**, **Trail**, **Aura**, or **Empty emitter** to build your own.
- Each one is a layer you can place, resize and recolour like a model.
rainium.tutorial.particles.note: Or press Next and one is added for you.
rainium.tutorial.hue.title: Recolour anything
rainium.tutorial.hue.body:
Both work on any layer, models too.
- **Hue** turns every colour around the colour wheel. Click the strip, or press − or +.
- **Tint** paints the whole layer towards one colour. Click the strip to pick the colour; the value sets how strong. Off keeps the original colours.
- Hue changes the texture first, then Tint colours the result.
rainium.tutorial.settings.title: Settings decide the rest
rainium.tutorial.settings.body:
- **Show layers** is the master switch for everything.
- **Show on** picks who wears it: just you, everyone, or a list of players.
- **Feel**, under Motion, sets how much layers sway as you move, from Still to Bouncy.
- Hover or click the small **i** beside a setting to read what it does.
rainium.tip.reactions: Make this react to what happens: show it after a totem pop, tint it when you're hit, spin it while you sprint... Opens the reactions editor.
rainium.tip.export_layer: Saves this layer, its files and its reactions as a zip in exports/, to share or keep. Add it again from Add > Sets.
rainium.react.none_yet: No reactions yet: it always looks the same.
rainium.react.title: Reactions
rainium.react.tip.switch: Switch all of this object's reactions on or off.
rainium.react.empty_hint: Press + Add node (or A, or double-click), or pick an example on the right. Wire an event or a state into an action.
rainium.react.intro: What %s does when things happen to the player wearing it. Click a node to change it.
rainium.react.intro_folder: What every part of %s does when things happen to the player wearing it (on top of each part's own reactions).
rainium.react.how.1: Yellow events are moments: a hit, a totem pop. Their diamond output fires once each time.
rainium.react.how.2: Blue states are on for a while: sneaking, low health. Their square output is a level from 0 to 1.
rainium.react.how.3: Drag from a node's output on the right to an input on the left. Drop a wire on empty space to add a node there.
rainium.react.how.4: Actions (pink) change this layer. After an event they fade in, hold and fade out; from a state they follow it, on and off.
rainium.react.how.5: Logic (purple) combines and shapes. Gates join two states, two events (with a time tolerance) or one of each. Others turn events into states, or filter them: cooldowns, combos, delays, chances.
rainium.react.how.6: Play button on an event, or the square on a state, tries it on you. Right-click a node to delete it; scroll to zoom, drag empty space to move around.
rainium.react.you_only: Only works on you: the game doesn't tell you this about other players.
rainium.react.particles_only: Only does something on a particle layer.
rainium.react.tip.test_event: Fire this event on yourself now, to try the reaction.
rainium.react.tip.test_state: Pretend this is true for you (until you switch it off), to try the reaction.
rainium.react.input.none: Not wired: wire an event or a state into it.
rainium.react.input.event: After the event: fades in, holds, fades out.
rainium.react.input.level: While the state is on: fades in, and out when it stops.
rainium.react.file.none: No .reactions.json files in the rainium folder or exports/.
rainium.react.file.clear_confirm: Click again to delete all nodes
rainium.react.msg.off: Reactions off: it always looks the same
rainium.react.msg.not_reactions: The clipboard doesn't hold Rainium reactions
rainium.react.msg.example_added: Example added: change it as you like
rainium.react.msg.bad_colour: Type a colour as 6 hex digits, like FF3050
rainium.react.msg.pick_none.effect: You don't have any effects right now
rainium.react.tip.pick.held: Use the item you're holding now.
rainium.react.tip.pick.using: Use the item you're holding now.
rainium.react.tip.pick.effect: Use one of the effects you have now (click again for the next).
rainium.react.tip.pick.dimension: Use the dimension you're in now.
rainium.react.tip.pick.biome: Use the biome you're standing in now.
rainium.react.why.self: Can't wire that: it can't connect to itself
rainium.react.why.no_output: Can't wire that: actions don't have an output
rainium.react.why.no_input: Can't wire that: nothing there takes this
rainium.react.why.needs_level: Can't wire that: that input needs a state (a level), not an event
rainium.react.why.needs_event: Can't wire that: that input needs an event, not a state
rainium.react.why.loop: Can't wire that: that would make a loop
rainium.react.curve.drag: Drag the handles to shape it.
rainium.react.node.hit.desc: You damage something. Limit it to players or mobs, or to a kind of damage.
rainium.react.node.hurt.desc: You lose health (or absorption). Limit it to a kind of damage, or set a minimum to skip small hits.
rainium.react.node.totem.desc: Your totem of undying saves you.
rainium.react.node.totem_opponent.desc: The one you're fighting pops a totem: whoever you last hit, or who last hit you, in the last 15 seconds.
rainium.react.node.kill.desc: Something you hurt in the last 5 seconds dies.
rainium.react.node.shield_break.desc: Your shield is disabled (by an axe).
rainium.react.node.swing.desc: You swing your arm (attacking or using).
rainium.react.node.jump.desc: You leave the ground going up.
rainium.react.node.land.desc: You land after a fall. Set how far the fall has to be.
rainium.react.node.shoot.desc: You let go of a drawn bow or trident.
rainium.react.node.eat.desc: You finish eating or drinking something.
rainium.react.node.interval.desc: Fires on its own, again and again.
rainium.react.node.health.desc: Your health is below (or above) a percentage, or how much is missing (fades with it).
rainium.react.node.absorption.desc: You have absorption hearts (golden apple, totem).
rainium.react.node.in_combat.desc: You hit something or got hit in the last few seconds.
rainium.react.node.moving.desc: You're moving faster than a set speed (walking is about 4 blocks/s).
rainium.react.node.airborne.desc: You're off the ground (jumping or falling, not gliding).
rainium.react.node.holding.desc: You're holding a chosen item (in either hand, or a chosen one).
rainium.react.node.using.desc: You're using an item (eating, drawing a bow, blocking...). Leave the item empty for any.
rainium.react.node.effect.desc: You have a chosen effect (speed, strength...).
rainium.react.node.hunger.desc: Your food bar is below a set amount.
rainium.react.node.night.desc: It's night (or dark outside) where you are.
rainium.react.node.dimension.desc: You're in a chosen dimension (the_nether, the_end, overworld).
rainium.react.node.and.desc: On while both inputs are on (the lower of the two).
rainium.react.node.or.desc: On while either input is on (the higher of the two).
rainium.react.node.not.desc: On while its input is off.
rainium.react.node.gate.desc: Lets an event through only while a state is on.
rainium.react.node.hold.desc: Turns an event into a state that stays on for a while (again resets the time).
rainium.react.node.toggle.desc: Each event switches it on or off.
rainium.react.node.switch.desc: One event switches it on, another switches it off.
rainium.react.node.starts.desc: Fires the moment a state turns on.
rainium.react.node.stops.desc: Fires the moment a state turns off.
rainium.react.node.chance.desc: Lets an event through only some of the time.
rainium.react.node.cooldown.desc: Lets an event through, then ignores it for a while.
rainium.react.node.every.desc: Lets every Nth event through (every 3rd hit...).
rainium.react.node.combo.desc: Fires after several events close together (3 hits within 2 seconds...).
rainium.react.node.delay.desc: Fires a while after the event.
rainium.react.node.show.desc: Hidden until this is on; then it fades in.
rainium.react.node.hide.desc: Fades out while this is on.
rainium.react.node.tint.desc: Colours it towards a chosen colour.
rainium.react.node.glow.desc: Lights it up, ignoring the world's light.
rainium.react.node.rainbow.desc: Cycles its colour through the rainbow.
rainium.react.node.spin.desc: Turns it around an upright axis while on, and it stays where it stopped.
rainium.react.node.particles.desc: On a particle layer: a burst of particles, and a different rate while on.
rainium.react.example.hold_totem: Only show while holding a totem
rainium.react.example.kill_burst: Burst of particles on a kill
rainium.react.node.double_pop.desc: You pop a second totem soon after the last one.
rainium.react.node.mace_smash.desc: You land a mace smash. Set how far you had to fall.
rainium.react.node.pearl_teleport.desc: You arrive where your ender pearl landed.
rainium.react.node.opponent_pearled.desc: The one you're fighting teleports with an ender pearl.
rainium.react.node.chorus.desc: You teleport by eating chorus fruit.
rainium.react.node.launched.desc: Something throws you up into the air fast (a wind charge, a wind burst...).
rainium.react.node.crystal_hit.desc: An end crystal's explosion hurts you.
rainium.react.node.anchor_blast.desc: A respawn anchor's explosion hurts you.
rainium.react.node.hit_by_projectile.des: An arrow, trident or other projectile hits you.
rainium.react.node.shot_player.desc: Your arrow, trident or other projectile hits a player.
rainium.react.node.disable_shield.desc: Your hit (with an axe) disables someone's shield.
A piece of armour of the one you're fighting breaks.
rainium.react.node.gapple.desc: You eat a golden apple (on others: absorption hearts appear).
rainium.react.node.close_call.desc: You survive a hit with little health left.
rainium.react.node.sweep.desc: You land a sweeping sword attack.
rainium.react.node.kill_streak.desc: Every so many kills without dying (3, 6, 9...).
rainium.react.node.assist.desc: Something you hurt in the last 10 seconds is finished off by someone else.
rainium.react.node.knockback.desc: A hit sends you flying back faster than a set speed.
rainium.react.node.armor_broke.desc: A piece of your armour breaks.
rainium.react.node.splashed.desc: A splash potion breaks right next to you.
rainium.react.node.riptide.desc: You launch with a riptide trident.
rainium.react.node.firework.desc: You boost your elytra with a firework.
rainium.react.node.dimension_change.desc: You go to another dimension (the Nether, the End...).
rainium.react.node.effect_gained.desc: You get an effect (pick one, or leave it empty for any).
rainium.react.node.effect_lost.desc: One of your effects ends (pick one, or leave it empty for any).
rainium.react.node.block_broken.desc: You break a block (pick one, or leave it empty for any).
rainium.react.node.block_placed.desc: You place a block (pick one, or leave it empty for any).
rainium.react.node.picked_up.desc: You pick up an item (pick one, or leave it empty for any).
rainium.react.node.chat.desc: You say something in chat with a chosen word in it (empty: any message).
rainium.react.node.falling.desc: You're falling from higher than a set height (good for mace hits).
rainium.react.node.opponent_health.desc: The health of the one you're fighting is below (or above) a percentage.
rainium.react.node.opponent_near.desc: The one you're fighting is within a set distance.
rainium.react.node.opponent_holding.desc: The one you're fighting holds a chosen item (mace, totem, end crystal...).
rainium.react.node.opponent_blocking.des: The one you're fighting has a shield up.
rainium.react.node.opponent_looking.desc: The one you're fighting is looking straight at you.
rainium.react.node.low_durability.desc: Your held item or armour is nearly broken.
rainium.react.node.totems_left.desc: You have fewer than a set number of totems on you.
rainium.react.node.item_cooldown.desc: A chosen item is on cooldown (ender pearl, chorus fruit, wind charge...).
rainium.react.node.shield_cooldown.desc: Your shield is disabled (cooling down after an axe hit).
rainium.react.node.game_mode.desc: You're in survival, creative or spectator.
rainium.react.node.nand.desc: Off only while both inputs are on. On otherwise.
rainium.react.node.nor.desc: On only while both inputs are off.
rainium.react.node.xor.desc: On while exactly one of the two inputs is on, not both.
rainium.react.node.xnor.desc: On while both inputs agree: both on, or both off.
rainium.react.node.both.desc: Fires when both events fire within the tolerance of each other (A then B, or B then A).
rainium.react.node.then.desc: Fires when B follows A within the tolerance. B before A does nothing.
rainium.react.node.without.desc: Fires when A happens and B does not, within the tolerance. It answers once the tolerance has passed.
rainium.react.node.one_of.desc: Fires when only one of the two happens, with no match from the other within the tolerance. It answers once the tolerance has passed.
rainium.react.node.unless.desc: Lets an event through only while a state is off.
rainium.react.node.blink.desc: Flashes on and off. Visible is how much of each flash it is shown.
rainium.react.node.flicker.desc: Dims at random, like a failing light.
rainium.react.node.tint_pulse.desc: Pulses a colour over it, in and out.
rainium.react.node.glow_pulse.desc: Pulses its brightness, in and out.
rainium.react.node.heartbeat.desc: Two quick beats, then a rest, like a heart.
rainium.react.node.sway.desc: Slides it back and forth along one axis.
rainium.react.node.wobble.desc: Rocks it back and forth around one axis.
rainium.react.node.roll.desc: Keeps turning around one axis, like Spin but on another axis.
rainium.react.node.shiver.desc: A fast, tiny trembling of its angle.
rainium.react.node.glitch.desc: Now and then it jumps aside and dims for a moment.
rainium.react.example.hit_flash: Red flash and shake when you get hurt
rainium.react.example.totem_pop: Grow and glow when you pop a totem
rainium.react.example.enemy_totem: Gold pulse when your opponent pops a totem
rainium.react.example.heartbeat_low: Heartbeat and red pulse at low health
rainium.react.example.danger_zone: Shiver and redden when low on health and in a fight (And gate)
rainium.react.example.kill_party: Rainbow and spin after a kill
rainium.react.example.streak_orbit: Orbit and glow for 10 seconds after a 3 kill streak
rainium.react.example.death_hide: Hide from death until respawn (On / off)
rainium.react.example.mace_slam: Shake and grow on a mace smash
rainium.react.example.swing_miss: Shiver when a swing hits nothing (Without gate)
rainium.react.example.trade: Gold pulse when you hit and get hit at once (Both gate)
rainium.react.example.worn_armour: Flicker when armour is nearly broken
rainium.tutorial.react_open.title: Make it react
rainium.tutorial.react_open.body:
A layer or folder can **react** to what happens to the player wearing it: a hit, a totem pop, sneaking, low health.
- Press **Add reactions** (or **Edit reactions**) in a layer's or folder's panel to open the nodes screen.
- They are saved with the layer and go into its export.
rainium.tutorial.react_open.note: Press **Open nodes** and the halo's nodes screen opens.
rainium.tutorial.react_canvas.title: Wire things together
rainium.tutorial.react_canvas.body:
- **Events** (yellow) are moments: a hit, a totem pop. **States** (blue) are on for a while: sneaking, low health.
- **Actions** (pink) change the layer: tint, spin, hide...
- Drag from a node's **right dot** to another's **left dot** to wire them. Drop a wire on empty space to add a node there.
- Drag nodes to move them, scroll to zoom, right-click a node to delete it.
rainium.tutorial.react_canvas.note: If the halo had no reactions, two examples were added to look at. Delete them any time.
rainium.tutorial.react_menu.title: Search, tabs and groups
rainium.tutorial.react_menu.body:
Open it with **+ Add node**, **A**, or a double-click on the canvas.
- **1 Search:** type to look through every node at once. **Enter** adds the first.
- **2 Tabs:** Events, States, Logic and Actions.
- **3 Groups:** narrow a tab down: PvP, Combat, Movement...
- **4 i:** hover or click the small **i** on a node to read what it does.
rainium.tutorial.react_gates.title: Combine triggers
rainium.tutorial.react_gates.body:
The **Logic** tab combines and shapes.
- **State gates:** And, Or, Not, Nand, Nor, Xor and Xnor join states.
- **Event gates:** Both, Then, Without and One of compare two events. Their **Tolerance** is how close in time the two must be.
- **State + event:** Only while and Unless let an event through while a state is on or off.
- The rest turn events into states (Hold, Toggle) or filter them (Chance, Cooldown, Combo, Delay).
rainium.tutorial.react_actions.title: Fade in, hold, fade out
rainium.tutorial.react_actions.body:
Click an action to set it up in the panel.
- After an **event** it fades in, holds, then fades out. From a **state** it follows the state on and off.
- **In** and **Out** are the times, each with an ease **curve**. The graph shows the shape.
- **Repeat** decides what a second event does: start again, hold longer or ignore it.
rainium.tutorial.react_try.title: Test it and share it
rainium.tutorial.react_try.body:
- Press the **play** button on an event, or the **square** on a state, to try it on yourself. Watch the preview.
- **Examples** on the right add a ready-made graph.
- **File** copies the graph as text or saves it to share. It also travels inside layer and folder exports.
rainium.tutorial.react_try.note: Replay this tour any time with **Replay tutorial** in Settings.
rainium.tip.lyrics_on: Shows the lyrics of the song playing on this computer in the world in front of you, in time with the music. Only you see them. They never cover the one you're fighting and never change your view.
rainium.lyrics.off_note: Plays along with Spotify or any music player on this computer. Off until you switch it on.
rainium.tip.lyrics_mode: Music video: the lyrics as a lyric video in the manner of JIZURA, with its colours, ghosting, HUD and kinetic type, drawn right here (nothing else to install). Simple: the line being sung, filling in word by word.
rainium.tip.lyrics_style: The look of the lyric video (JIZURA's twelve styles): colours, type and the kind of motion.
rainium.tip.lyrics_motifs: Adds a red seal, a brush circle and a vertical katakana tag.
rainium.tip.lyrics_new_effects: Adds glitch tears: strips of the picture slip sideways for a moment.
rainium.tip.lyrics_size: How much of the screen the lyrics may take. They shrink further when they need room beside an enemy.
rainium.tip.lyrics_through_blocks: On: blocks never hide the lyrics. Off: a wall in front of you can cover them.
rainium.tip.lyrics_demo: Plays a short built-in song (just the lyrics, no sound) so you can try the looks without music.
rainium.tip.lyrics_player: Windows: the player in the volume flyout. macOS: Spotify or Apple Music (macOS asks once to let Minecraft read them). Linux: any player, through playerctl.
rainium.tip.lyrics_online: Looks lyrics up on lrclib.net, a free lyrics site. Only the song's title, artist, album and length are sent. Lyrics are saved on this computer, so each song is looked up once.
rainium.lyrics.online_on: Lyrics come from lrclib.net, your own .lrc files, or ones saved earlier.
rainium.lyrics.online_off: Only your own .lrc files (named "Artist - Title.lrc" in the lyrics folder) and lyrics saved earlier are used.
rainium.tip.lyrics_offset: Moves the lyrics later (+) or earlier (−) if they don't match the music, for example with Bluetooth headphones.
rainium.tip.lyrics_chat: A line in your chat when the song changes. Only you see it; it's never sent to the server.
rainium.lyrics.status.plain_only: %s only has untimed lyrics, so nothing is shown.
rainium.lyrics.status.offline: No lyrics saved for %s. Turn on Find lyrics online, or add a .lrc file.
rainium.lyrics.status.failed: Couldn't look up the lyrics of %s.
rainium.lyrics.problem.playerctl: Install playerctl so Rainium can see what's playing.
rainium.lyrics.problem.mac: Couldn't ask Spotify or Music what's playing (allow Minecraft in System Settings > Privacy > Automation).
rainium.lyrics.problem.windows: Couldn't start the Windows media reader (PowerShell).
